payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (column index, last color). For each j and segment length k in [x,y], transitions from opposite color at j-k, accumulating pixel repaint costs.
payload.rationale: Uses 2D DP table dp[color][j] to track min repaints ending in white or black. Transitions by trying all valid run lengths, updating from the alternate color's optimal cost. Fits 'dp_2d_state' exactly.
